retrievalProfile.description: A classic 1960s soul album layout featuring a large plum-colored field with high-contrast, multi-layered typography and a small, white-bordered central portrait.
triggerTerms: framed central portrait with large header text

recipe.visualDefinition: A formal, symmetrical composition dominated by a deep plum background. The top half features two tiers of large, stylized text in orange and white, while the bottom half contains a vertically oriented rectangular photograph of a seated performer framed by a thin white border. Small metadata and tracklist text are distributed at the extreme top and bottom edges.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical vertical alignment of text and image
High contrast between the plum background and the orange/white typography
Hierarchical scale transition from large display titles to tiny tracklist text
Framing of a dark-background photo within a light-bordered inset
coreInvariants: Deep plum or burgundy solid background
Thin white border around the central image
Stacked display typography in the upper third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A small, vertically oriented rectangular portrait centered in the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white slab-serif artist name in the center-top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: starting with the orange title, moving to the white artist name, then down to the framed portrait, ending at the bottom tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive plum-colored negative space surrounding the central elements, creating a sense of formal elegance.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-saturation, dark background contrasted with high-value, medium-saturation foreground elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of ultra-condensed sans-serif and heavy slab serif.
letterConstructionRules: Top line: Extremely tall, narrow, flat-sided sans-serif
Second line: Wide, heavy slab serif with square terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' and 'R' in the top line have extremely high waistlines
The 'S' in the slab serif has deep, horizontal curves
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between vertical tension (condensed sans) and horizontal stability (wide slab serif).
graphicDevices: Thin white rectangular frame for the photo

preserve: Slab serif for the artist name
avoid: Serif fonts with high stroke contrast (Didone)

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the ultra-condensed verticality of the top title.
Provides the sturdy slab-serif structure for the artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid plum-colored background. In the lower center, place a vertical rectangular photograph of a man in a white shirt seated on a stool against a dark backdrop, framed by a thin white line.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large orange ultra-condensed sans-serif text at the top. Below it, add large white slab-serif text. Add tiny white metadata text at the extreme top-left and bottom edges.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent deep plum?
Are the two main text lines centered and stacked?
Is the photo framed with a thin white border?
Is the color contrast between orange, white, and plum maintained?

adjustableVariables: Background color hue (e.g., navy or forest green)
Accent color for the top title
Aspect ratio of the central photo frame
postGenerationChecks: Check that the orange text is taller than the white text.
Ensure the white border around the photo is uniform and thin.
Verify that the bottom tracklist is legible but very small.
Confirm the background color is a solid, dark purple-red.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid dark background + Stacked high-contrast display type + Framed central portrait + Minimalist metadata border text.
